items.title: Glimpse Matcha holiday storefront, Pearl District
items.description: A temporary matcha storefront in the Pearl District, open Nov 13 to Dec 31. Drop in for freshly whisked matcha drinks while the holiday shop is up.
items.notes: Instagram snippet: "Matcha in Portland's Pearl District from November 13th - December 31st! 433 NW 10th Ave... thurs-sun | 10am-6pm". Another snippet says "6 days"; Thu-Sun hours taken from the later quote. One item per Thu-Sun date in the first two weeks of the window; Thanksgiving skipped. Street address from the snippet, not a fetched page, so likely not confirmed. A reel says it is hosted with Portland Downtown Clean & Safe.
